id_and_class.summary: Susan Schneider and Mark Bailey propose that spacetime emerges from ‘prototime,’ a non-spatial, directionless quasi-temporal dimension in which quantum entanglement holds. The entangled whole at that level, an entanglement ‘megaobject,’ has a higher form of consciousness than anything in spacetime: maximally coherent, zero-entropy and fully integrated. They call this superpsychism, and they claim the same prototime picture explains puzzling quantum phenomena.

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: The deepest form of consciousness is superconsciousness: experiential states in maximal coherence, perfect phase coordination and zero entropy, belonging to the holistically entangled structure beneath spacetime.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Consciousness supervenes on the fundamental physical level; if spacetime emerges from entanglement, then cognitive, phenomenal and perceptual states in brains supervene on that entangled base.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (consciousness is present at the fundamental, pre-spacetime level; spacetime and its occupants emerge from it)
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Prototime as a second, arrowless quasi-temporal dimension; non-spatiotemporal quantum entanglement; an entanglement megaobject with superconscious experience; emergent spacetime.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Inference to the best explanation from quantum phenomena, combined with philosophical argument about supervenience.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A web of entanglements outside spacetime forming one megaobject, from which the classical world and its entities emerge.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: The fundamental nature and location of consciousness, and its relation to quantum physics.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Persistent coherence across past, present and future in entangled systems, holding in prototime, produces unified experience in the entanglement object.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Time acquires a definite direction upon decoherence, so spacetime with its arrow of time emerges from arrowless prototime without creating time paradoxes.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Outside space and time, in the entangled structure underlying spacetime; Schneider and Bailey set this against cosmopsychism, which places the fundamental consciousness in the universe as a whole.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Holistic entanglement and maximal resonance integrate the megaobject's conscious states more fully than any spatiotemporal mind can.
core_claims_and_evidence: The universe may have two temporal dimensions: ordinary time with an arrow, and an arrowless quasi-temporal parameter called prototime.
The prototime interpretation could be the best explanation of superposition, no-signaling, nonlocality, wave-particle duality, the double-slit experiment and delayed choice.
Property dualists, panpsychists and physicalists agree that consciousness supervenes on the fundamental physical level, so brain consciousness should depend somehow on quantum phenomena.
The entanglement megaobject has a higher form of consciousness than spacetime entities.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Philosophical and interpretive, built on an interpretation of quantum mechanics.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Schneider and Bailey call the claim that prototime best explains quantum phenomena controversial. The view variously describes the base level as superconscious and as protoconscious, leaving its exact status unclear.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Schneider and Bailey say it would be premature to conclude that we are creations of a cosmic mind or inside God's mind; the superconsciousness could equally be a natural phenomenon or the workings of a vast simulation.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: The view inverts standard panpsychism by putting the richest consciousness at the most fundamental level rather than building it up from simple micro-experiences.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Schneider and Bailey find it natural to wonder whether superconsciousness is a cosmic mind or God but decline to conclude it, leaving open that it is a natural phenomenon or a simulation.

sources_and_references.title_with_names: Schneider and Bailey’s Entangled Superpsychism (Landscape of Consciousness), Susan Schneider, Mark Bailey
